The Customer Support (CS) organization is responsible for the installations, qualification, repair and maintenance of the ASML systems at customer sites and is responsible for the necessary transfer of know-how to the customer. Local site Customer Support branches perform these tasks for the customer within the specific region.
Executes system Upgrade & Installations and Relocations and provides technical support for other CS activities when needed. Conducts mostly well-defined tasks, with a higher degree of independency and under limited supervision.
Requirements
Requires flexibilty and openess to accommodate various work settings, locations and interactions/collaborations with different colleagues.
Experienced UIR Engineer with BSc degree in relevant Technical Field (Electrical Technology, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, etc.) or equivalent experience.
Experienced in technical industry is required and/or semiconductor industry experience prefered.
Experience in using computer applications, including data analysis tools, spreadsheet, and presentation software.
Responsibilities
Problem analysis and approach
Gather all information relevant for the problem, analyze using available means, gather additional diagnostic info if needed, decide on initial approach to solve problem and execute, consult with others.
Problem handovers and routing
Handover problem or problem aspects to others (2nd line support), document and package all data relevant for problem resolution (e.g. pass-downs, work orders, field service reports, system problem reports, technical reports).
Installation
Install equipment at customers locations, including equipment with new features, unload components, inspect for damage, assemble, align and test.
Upgrade
Execute hardware installation and perform system setup/recovery for upgrade packages as well as support locally owned field swaps by working according to an up-to-date plan and following the sequence.
Provide feedback during execution in order to improve cycle time and performance.
Procedures
Based on arranged customer machine time window to arrange for all (possible) parts, tools, equipment and information / knowledge to be available at start of procedure, execute procedure.
Process Optimization
Signal gaps and improvement opportunities and reports it to the relevant stakeholders
Training / advice
Explain appropriate actions to users to correct malfunctions, train customers in use and routine maintenance of equipment, recommend changes in user procedures when needed.
Knowledge build-up and transfer
Maintain and broaden own knowledge, shares best known methods within the work group.
Coaching
Provide appropriate support and assistance to less experienced engineers on first tasks.

postings.description:
3PL Warehouse Manager
In a nutshell
Location
San Diego, CA, US

Sourcing and Supply Chain Management
Work experience
4-9 years
Educational background
Materials Science
Travel
25%
Workplace type
On-Site
Fulltime/parttime
Full time
Third-Party Logistics (3PL) Management Focus
Lead the operational performance and governance of ASML's third-party logistics warehouse partners, ensuring reliable service, inventory accuracy, quality, compliance, cost control, and continuous improvement.
Introduction to the Job
As a Warehouse Operations Manager at ASML, you will serve as the primary operational lead responsible for managing and governing third-party logistics (3PL) warehouse providers that support ASML's manufacturing, field service, inventory control, and reverse logistics operations. You will ensure external logistics partners meet ASML's expectations for inventory accuracy, service levels, quality, compliance, cost, capacity, and delivery performance.
Rather than directly supervising day-to-day warehouse labor, you will drive results through external provider leadership. You will establish clear expectations, monitor performance, lead operational reviews, manage escalations, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained. You will build strong partnerships across ASML and with the 3PL while maintaining accountability for business outcomes.
Role and Responsibilities
As a Warehouse Operations Manager, you will own the operational governance and performance of outsourced warehouse operations. You will work closely with 3PL leadership, logistics partners, suppliers, and internal teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and support changing business needs.
3PL Governance and Performance Management
Serve as the primary operational relationship manager for third-party warehouse providers.
Establish, monitor, and continuously improve contractual service-level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational scorecards.
Conduct regular operational reviews and formal business reviews with 3PL leadership, including performance trends, risks, capacity, quality, cost, and improvement priorities.
Hold external providers accountable for receiving, putaway, storage, inventory control, picking, packing, shipping, ticket resolution, returns processing, and reverse logistics.
Drive root-cause analysis and corrective-action plans when inventory, quality, safety, delivery, cost, or service targets are missed.
Escalate recurring or material performance issues through defined governance channels and verify that corrective actions are implemented and sustained.
Influence provider performance without direct authority by setting clear expectations, using data, and maintaining constructive accountability.
Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders to support contract execution, scope alignment, and service expectations.
Warehouse Operations and Material Flow
Ensure inbound and outbound material flow supports manufacturing, field service, inventory control, and reverse logistics requirements.
Monitor warehouse capacity, space utilization, workflow efficiency, throughput, labor readiness, shrinkage, and operational risk.
Ensure the 3PL maintains safe, compliant, accurate, and reliable processes across all warehouse activities.
Coordinate changing business priorities, volume fluctuations, urgent material needs, and capacity constraints with the provider and internal stakeholders.
Oversee returns, RMA, disposition, and reverse-logistics performance, including turnaround time, traceability, and inventory accuracy.
Inventory, Quality, and Continuous Improvement
Drive inventory accuracy through cycle counting, physical inventories, audits, reconciliation, discrepancy resolution, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Monitor inventory accuracy, transaction quality, aging, shrinkage, damage, and material traceability across the external warehouse operation.
Challenge existing processes and lead improvement initiatives that strengthen quality, delivery, cost, capacity, and operational reliability.
Use warehouse data and provider reporting to identify trends, quantify risk, and prioritize practical improvement opportunities.
Ensure provider procedures and controls meet ASML quality, safety, security, and compliance expectations.
Financial and Resource Management
Oversee annual warehouse budget planning, monthly cost tracking, forecast updates, and resource planning with the 3PL.
Review provider labor, overtime, capacity, productivity, accessorial charges, and other cost drivers to ensure efficient execution.
Partner with the provider and internal teams to develop business cases, cost-reduction opportunities, and investment recommendations.
Cross-Functional Partnership
Build strong working relationships with Supply Chain, Procurement, Planning, Quality, Manufacturing, Field Service, Finance, and logistics partners.
Communicate priorities, risks, decisions, status updates, and escalations clearly to internal stakeholders and provider leadership.
Balance day-to-day operational details with broader supply chain and business priorities.
Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, logistics, business, operations management, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience managing established contract-logistics or 3PL warehouse providers in a complex, high-volume environment.
Experience managing warehouse operations through outsourced providers rather than solely through directly employed warehouse teams.
5 to 7 years of relevant experience in 3PL warehouse operations.
At least 3 years of direct experience managing, governing, or overseeing third-party logistics providers, outsourced warehouse operations, or contract logistics partners.
Demonstrated experience holding external warehouse providers accountable to SLAs, operational KPIs, inventory-accuracy expectations, quality requirements, and corrective-action plans.
Experience conducting provider performance reviews, business reviews, scorecard discussions, and escalations with 3PL leadership.
Experience supporting 3PL warehouse operations in a manufacturing, technology, medical-device, aerospace, semiconductor, or service-parts environment.
Experience with 3PL warehouse budgets, cost tracking, capacity planning, and provider resource planning.
Ability to work on-site and travel up to 25%, based on business needs.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, medical device, aerospace, capital equipment, or complex service-parts logistics.
Experience with SAP, warehouse management systems (WMS), inventory-control systems, dashboards, and provider scorecard reporting.
Lean, Six Sigma, continuous-improvement, or supply-chain certification.
Experience with reverse logistics, RMA, repair loops, returns, and disposition processes.
Success in This Role
Success will be measured by the ability to improve and sustain 3PL performance across inventory accuracy, receiving and shipping execution, service levels, quality, safety, capacity, cost, reverse logistics, issue resolution, and stakeholder satisfaction. The successful candidate will demonstrate that they can combine partnership with accountability and drive results through an external provider organization.
The current base annual salary range for this role is currently:
Pay scales are determined by role, level, location and alignment with market data. Individual pay is determined through interviews and an assessment of several factors that that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, abilities of the candidate and pay relative to other team members.
The Company offers employees and their families, medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees are able to participate in the Company’s 401k plan. Employees will also receive eight (8) hours of vacation leave every month and (13) paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Job Description Summary
At Cymer Korea Factory, quality is central to how we build customer confidence, strengthen manufacturing performance, and enable reliable delivery of advanced technology. The Quality team partners across Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality Management, Service, suppliers, and global teams to prevent issues, solve problems with data, and continuously improve products, processes, and systems.
We are looking for a Junior Manufacturing Quality Engineer who wants to grow as a hands-on quality professional in a high-tech manufacturing environment. In this role, you will investigate manufacturing and supplier quality issues, use structured problem solving to identify root causes, support corrective and preventive actions, and help improve quality controls.
This is a strong opportunity for an early-career engineer to build broad experience in manufacturing quality, supplier quality, quality systems, and cross-functional collaboration.
Introduction to the Job
This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to product quality, customer trust, and operational excellence at Cymer Korea Factory.
You will work closely with experienced engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to analyze quality data, identify risks, improve procedures and controls, and drive practical improvement actions.
The position is well suited for a quality-minded engineer who enjoys solving problems, learning complex manufacturing processes, and building technical ownership over time.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor manufacturing quality performance and help identify product, process, material, and supplier-related quality risks.
Investigate assigned quality issues using data analysis and structured problem-solving methods.
Support containment, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, and effectiveness verification using applicable quality tools.
Improve quality procedures, inspection standards, work instructions, control plans, and day-to-day manufacturing quality processes.
Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality Management, Service, and suppliers to resolve issues and close actions.
Support supplier and incoming material quality improvement, audits, risk assessments, and continuous improvement activities.
Prepare clear quality reports, escalate significant risks promptly, and share lessons learned.
Required Quallifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Applied Physics, or a comparable technical discipline.
Typically 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, process engineering, product quality, supplier quality, or quality assurance.
Hands-on experience with manufacturing or supplier quality issues, data analysis, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Working knowledge of quality tools and systems such as 8D, FMEA, SPC, QC tools, nonconformance management, and ISO 9001.
Ability to interpret quality data, manage assigned priorities, and drive actions to verified closure.
Effective cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, with professional working proficiency in Korean and English.
Ownership mindset and willingness to escalate risks or request support when issues exceed the assigned scope.
Preferred Qualifications
Demonstrate ownership of assigned quality issues and follow actions through to verified closure.
Make recommendations based on facts, data, risk, and customer impact.
Escalate significant risks and barriers clearly and in a timely manner.
Actively seek technical guidance and feedback when addressing unfamiliar or complex problems.
Share lessons learned and contribute to standardization across relevant manufacturing areas.
Culture and Community
Actively promote/use of the Q&E Reward & Recognition program and Q&E Communication Strategy.
Be an active member within the Q&E Community and related events.

Our main headquarters are located in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we also have 18 office locations around the United States- including main offices in Wilton, CT, Chandler, AZ, San Jose, CA and San Diego, CA.

APAC Treasury Specialist
Introduction
ASML Korea is looking for a APAC Treasury Specialist
Are you up for a new challenge in one of the World’s top multinational companies? Are you a strong hands-on professional with broad treasury experience and excellent stakeholders management skills? Are you well-versed in cash and financial risk management, inter-company and bank financing, treasury interactions with business projects and compliance with regulations in Korea and broader APAC? Are you a relationship builder who can navigate successfully in a complex stakeholders’ landscape and be able to convince senior leaders? Then this role might be something for you. We are looking for a professional who makes a difference because it’s in your nature to understand the multinational business of ASML and to translate that into effective and efficient risk management and cash centralization strategies, financing solutions and secure treasury related compliance.
Job Mission
At ASML we constantly have to ensure that our people, expertise and information enable us to realize our growth and meet our ambitious business objectives. Especially in the fast growing and demanding semiconductor business in which we operate, it requires Treasury to bring breakthrough and creative solutions and go beyond the established paths enabling ASML’s future growth and success.
Treasury is a part of the Expert Advisory team which includes the expertise areas of treasury, tax, legal and accounting. These disciplines are closely working together to support the business with integrated expertise and advice.
You will be responsible for the overall APAC Treasury of ASML’s business in Korea and support other APAC countries, that include China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, India. You will be an integral part of the global corporate treasury team, with members located in the Netherlands, Korea, China and the US as well as the broader Expert Advisory team. You will report to the Local Treasury Manager.
Role and responsibilities
The APAC Treasury Specialist is responsible for:
- Lead daily in-house cash monitoring and analysis, intercompany financing/capital structure monitoring (thin cap and delineation review) and provide support to regional Treasury Managers on action items for APAC countries.
- Close collaboration with Senior Treasury Specialist (HQ ICY financing team) and Tax department to ensure sufficient liquidity for the ASML Group’s APAC subsidiaries to operate their business and support strategic growth projects and to ensure that their capital structure is in accordance with ASML’s policies and local Treasury and Tax laws & regulation and transfer pricing principles.
- Implement the intercompany (IC) policies for the APAC entities. Support regional Treasury Managers, and educate and lead stakeholders (Expert Advisory Team(EA), Finance, Shared team) to ensure proper execution of the intercompany (IC) policies.
- Provide integrated Treasury (compliance) expertise, advice and requirements in EA projects, larger-scale Finance projects and Strategic Business initiatives in close alignment with the Treasury subject matter experts to ensure that the Treasury requirements are addressed and proposals are embedded in Treasury processes; coordinate proposals submitted by Treasury to ensure cross functional alignment and execution. Represent Treasury in project core team meetings.
- Provide supporting roles on short-term cash forecasting, daily liquidity management, investment and FX management for all APAC countries.
- Together with EA Triage team members to allocate resources to EA Triage projects and make decisions to optimize the EA Triage process.
- Assist in the periodic reviewing of policies in Treasury (focus on Korea and other APAC countries), in consultation with the owner of the policy, ensuring that the policy meets the internal requirements and standards.
- Business partnering with other Finance functions, sectors and business lines in close collaboration with other expertise functions.
- Maintain relationships with external partners (including banks, external counsel and advisors) and with internal partners (Finance, Legal, Tax, Customs, Accounting, etc).
- Support on Korea Treasury administrative works
Education and experience
Bachelor’s degree in relevant field with strong analytical and problem solving ability.
Excellent in both Korean and English; verbally and in writing. Other APAC languages (especially Chinese) would be considered as an asset.
10 years’ experience in Finance/Treasury in large globally operating companies with demonstrated Treasury achievements
In depth knowledge of Treasury and Treasury technological solutions
In depth knowledge of E2E processes related to Treasury
Extensive knowledge of laws and regulations applicable to the industry and ASML, its products and markets, clients and processes on all relevant aspects of Treasury
Good knowledge of relevant accounting, legal and tax aspects and overlapping areas with Treasury
Good knowledge of ASML business model, tax model and IC flows
Skills
Highest level of ethics, loyalty and personal integrity.
Strong drive with a hands-on, structured, accurate and result oriented working style.
Team player with the ability to build relationships with colleagues globally, also in other functional areas.
Strives for continuous improvement.
Committed and flexible (going the extra mile).
Has a strategic and innovative mindset.
Creative and pro-active in anticipating changes in business activities and their risk consequences.

ASML strongly believes in unlocking the potential of people and society by pushing technology to new limits. Our invitation to you is to be a part of the team that ensures ASML’s purpose can continue to be successful by protecting and securing its physical, informational and digital assets. This dynamic and challenging environment requires detail-oriented and passionate about security professionals.
As an application security subject matter expert, you will be focusing on multiple areas of expertise covering application and infrastructure across both on-premises and cloud environments, including SaaS solutions.
Role and responsibilities
This function is positioned in the Second Line Security organization. Together with your colleagues, you will be responsible for defining security controls for new and existing IT solutions within ASML. You will perform in-depth security assessments to verify that IT security requirements are correctly implemented and effectively enforced within specific solutions. Introduction to the job
ASML is a high-tech company and a leading supplier to the semiconductor industry. We manufacture the advanced lithography systems that chipmakers use to produce computer chips. What we do is at the heart of the electronic devices that inform, entertain, and connect us. At our Berlin site, more than 1,800 employees develop and manufacture key components for ASML lithography systems.
During the Fine Optics Apprenticeship, you can expect an exciting combination of theory and practice. In our in-house training workshop, you will work with modern equipment and manufacturing processes that are in demand worldwide. Throughout your apprenticeship, you will receive individual support and be well prepared for the start of your career in a future-oriented industry.
Role and responsibilities
As a fine optics apprentice, you will:
manufacture optical components from raw materials to finished high-tech products.
learn how to manually process glass and ceramics before using modern precision machinery.
grind, polish, measure, and inspect optical components according to technical specifications.
combine manual craftsmanship with modern manufacturing technologies.
use and maintain tools, measuring equipment, and machinery safely.
gain practical experience in different manufacturing areas, including cleanrooms.
complete practical training in our in-house training workshop and apply your theoretical knowledge in a manufacturing environment.
Education and experience
Secondary school certificate, university of applied sciences entrance qualification, or general university entrance qualification
Interest in mathematics, physics, natural sciences, or engineering
Interest in working with computers and high-tech equipment
Interest in learning both manual and machine-based precision manufacturing processes
Professional proficiency in German, both spoken and written
Skills
Working in precision manufacturing requires concentration, care, and a strong awareness of quality. To succeed in this apprenticeship, the following skills are important:
Patience and perseverance when working on demanding precision tasks
Steady hands and excellent manual dexterity
Curiosity, willingness to learn, and reliability
Enjoyment of teamwork and open communication
Flexibility and openness to different assignments and early working hours
Other information
The apprenticeship starts on September 1, 2027.
Please submit your résumé, cover letter, and most recent school report and internship references with your application.
What we offer

As an Area Manager, you will serve as a hands-on leader, ensuring the safe, on-time delivery of high-quality products to both internal and external customers. In this role, you will drive continuous improvement in processes, operational effectiveness, and efficiency across your area of responsibility. You will proactively identify opportunities for enhancement and lead initiatives that elevate overall performance.
You will build and maintain a strong partnership with our sister facility in Berlin, Germany, to exchange best practices and align on operational excellence. In collaboration with Production and Development Engineers, you will play a key role in the adoption and industrialization of new products and processes.
Success in this role requires a collaborative mindset—you thrive as a team player and take equal pride in the achievements of your team members as in your own.
Lead and supervise a team of >5 or more direct reports, with an overall organizational scope of more than 30 employees.
Manage multiple work centers, competencies, or shifts, often involving a broad technical scope and complex, cross-functional stakeholder engagement.
Coordinate activities requiring advanced vocational expertise or experienced Bachelor's-level thinking, while applying your own academic-level analysis and decision-making.
Key Responsibilities
1. Operational Leadership & Delivery
Lead manufacturing operations within the BCELL area, which includes several advanced optical production processes:
- Bonding – assembling precision optical components
Contacting – joining optical surfaces at a microscopic level for high-performance systems
Etching – shaping and refining surfaces using controlled material removal techniques
Lithography – applying patterns to optical surfaces using light-based processes

Introduction
The Virtual Computing Platform team in Veldhoven develops and operates cloud-based platforms that support software development, testing, and qualification activities across ASML. As cloud adoption continues to grow, understanding and managing cloud expenditure becomes increasingly important. Cloud spending is often distributed across multiple teams, applications, and environments, making it challenging to identify optimization opportunities and gain clear cost insights.
During this internship, you will explore how Artificial Intelligence can improve cloud cost visibility, optimization, and decision-making. You will work on practical AI solutions that help engineering teams better understand spending patterns, identify cost-saving opportunities, and support proactive cloud cost management in a large-scale engineering environment.
Your assignment
In this internship, you will collaborate with cloud architects, platform engineers, product teams, and FinOps stakeholders to identify where AI can add the most value in cloud cost management. Rather than focusing on theoretical research, you will develop and validate practical AI solutions that improve cloud cost visibility, forecasting, and optimization.
Your main responsibilities will be:
Analyze cloud consumption and spending patterns across engineering environments
Develop AI-driven prototypes and proof-of-concepts for Cloud Cost Intelligence
Build AI agents that support cost attribution, optimization analysis, forecasting, and recommendation generation
Explore how AI can improve cloud cost transparency and optimization activities
Measure the impact and business value of proposed solutions
Present findings, recommendations, and adoption guidance to stakeholders

Introductie van de functie
Werk je graag met je handen en bouw je graag technische producten? Als assemblage monteur bij ASML help je mee aan de bouw van de meest geavanceerde machines ter wereld. Deze machines worden gebruikt voor de productie van computerchips. Je vindt deze chips terug in telefoons, auto's, medische apparatuur en vele andere producten die mensen dagelijks gebruiken.
Je werkt met moderne technologie en volgt duidelijke werkinstructies. Je werkt samen met collega’s aan technische vraagstukken. Houd je van nauwkeurig werken en wil je jezelf blijven ontwikkelen? Dan is deze functie misschien iets voor jou.
Functie en verantwoordelijkheden
In onze cleanroom fabrieken werken assemblage monteurs op verschillende afdelingen. Denk aan het bouwen van modules, het samenstellen van complete systemen en het testen van machines.
Je hoeft maar één keer te solliciteren op een van onze vacatures. Tijdens de selectie kijken we welke afdeling het beste past bij jouw ervaring en vaardigheden.
Afhankelijk van het team ga je:
Mechanische, elektrische en mechatronische onderdelen monteren, aansluiten en afstellen.
Werken met technische tekeningen en werkinstructies.
Onderdelen en machines meten en testen.
Technische problemen onderzoeken en oplossen.
Je werkzaamheden en testresultaten registreren in digitale systemen.
Werken volgens kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en cleanroomregels.
Opleiding en ervaring
We zoeken technici met verschillende achtergronden. Ervaring in de chipindustrie is niet nodig. Belangrijker zijn jouw technische vaardigheden, praktijkervaring en motivatie om te leren.
Daarnaast heb je:
Een technische opleiding op mbo-niveau 3 of 4, of een vergelijkbaar diploma. Bijvoorbeeld in werktuigbouwkunde, mechatronica, autotechniek of een andere technische richting.
Minimaal 2 jaar praktijkervaring met machines, technische installaties of mechatronische systemen.
Ervaring met het lezen van technische tekeningen en werkinstructies.
Ervaring met meten, testen of het oplossen van technische problemen.
Voldoende kennis van de Engelse taal om in een technische werkomgeving te communiceren.
Basisvaardigheden in het werken met computers en digitale systemen.
Bereidheid om in een tweeploegendienst te werken.
Vaardigheden
Je:
Werkt graag samen met collega's.
Werkt nauwkeurig en let op kwaliteit.
Lost problemen praktisch op.
Kunt omgaan met veranderingen in het werk.
Denkt mee over verbeteringen in processen.
Overige informatie
Leren en ontwikkelen
Je krijgt een goed inwerkprogramma en begeleiding van ervaren collega's.
Je hoeft niet alles vanaf de eerste dag te kunnen. Je leert stap voor stap in de praktijk.
Naarmate je meer ervaring krijgt, kun je doorgroeien naar andere technische werkzaamheden en verantwoordelijkheden.
ASML helpt je om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale hightech werkomgeving.
Praktische informatie
Deze functie is in Veldhoven.
Je werkt in een tweeploegendienst:
Vroege dienst: 06.30 tot 15.30 uur
Late dienst: 15.00 tot 00.00 uur
Je werkt één weekend per maand.
Werken in ploegendienst kan invloed hebben op je dagelijkse ritme en slaappatroon. Tegelijkertijd biedt ploegendienst meer vrije tijd overdag, die je kunt besteden aan hobby’s, vrienden of familie. Voor het werken in ploegendienst ontvang je een extra ploegentoeslag.
Voor deze functie ligt het vaste bruto jaarsalaris tussen €47.500 en €53.500. Dit bedrag is inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. Winstuitkering en ploegentoeslag komen daar nog bovenop. Je uiteindelijke salaris hangt af van je ervaring, opleiding, certificaten en prestaties tijdens de selectieprocedure.
Kom je vanuit het buitenland naar Nederland? Dan ondersteunt ASML je bij je verhuizing en tijdelijke huisvesting. Heb je een visum nodig om in Nederland te werken? Bekijk dan de voorwaarden op de website van de IND.
Interesse?
Solliciteer op de functie van assemblagemonteur met je cv in het Nederlands of Engels. Vertel ons met welke machines, systemen of technische installaties je ervaring hebt. We horen ook graag aan wat voor soort technische vraagstukken je hebt gewerkt.

Introduction to the job
Do you enjoy hands-on technical work? As an Assembler Technician at ASML, you help build some of the most advanced machines in the world. These machines are used to make computer chips. These chips are used in products people use every day.
You will work with advanced technology and follow clear work instructions. Together with your team, you solve technical challenges. If you enjoy precision work and want to keep learning, this could be the right job for you.
Role and responsibilities
Within our cleanroom factories, Assembler Technicians work in different areas, such as precision module assembly, system integration, testing, and qualification. You only need to apply once. During the selection process, we will match you to the team that best fits your skills, experience, and technical strengths.
Depending on your team, you will:
Assemble, connect, and align mechanical, electrical, and mechatronic components.
Work from technical drawings and detailed work instructions.
Measure and test parts and systems.
Investigate technical issues and solve problems.
Record work, test results, and issues in digital systems.
Work according to strict quality, safety and cleanroom procedures.
Education and experience
We welcome technicians from a wide range of technical backgrounds. Experience in the semiconductor industry is not required. What matters most is your practical technical skills, experience, and willingness to learn.
Next to that, you have:
A vocational/practical qualification (comparable to Dutch MBO level 3 or 4) in a technical field such as mechanical engineering, mechatronics, automotive technology or a related discipline.
At least 2 years of hands-on experience with mechanical, electrical or mechatronic systems, machines, or technical equipment.
Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
Experience with measurements, diagnostics, testing, or troubleshooting.
Ability to communicate in English in a technical work environment.
Basic confidence using digital tools, production systems, and computer-based work instructions.
Willingness to work on a two-shift schedule
Skills

Enjoy working with others.
Work accurately and focus on quality.
Solve problems in a practical way.
Adapt when priorities change.
Look for ways to improve your work and processes.

You will receive structured onboarding and support from experienced colleagues.
You do not need to master every ASML process from day one; you will learn through coaching, hands-on experience, and clear work instructions.
As your experience grows, you can develop further in areas such as system integration, precision alignment, qualification, troubleshooting, process improvement, or technical coaching.
ASML supports continuous learning and offers opportunities to grow your technical expertise within a global high-tech environment.

Introduction to the job
The EUV Source team in San Diego operates in a fast-paced, uniquely innovative and challenging environment to create new-to-industry solutions with rapid productization to support an aggressive commercialization plan for the EUV technology within ASML. The Plasma 600W Department is responsible for the development, integration and support of the automation and control loops for the EUV light source system. The complexity of the EUV source puts exciting and challenging demands on the Plasma Control Engineers who will be engaged in all phases of the control system development and integration involving sophisticated control algorithms, real-time embedded software, high speed electronics, precision sensors, and all working under extremely challenging dynamic conditions to produce stable EUV light.
Role and responsibilities
As an Automation/Controls Engineer you will:
Lead and perform integration activities including designing and executing test plans, troubleshooting the control system, to ensure the system functions as designed in the EUV light source. Such activities can take place in lab test bench and manufacturing cleanroom at various ASML sites.
Provide technical ownership for one or more control, optimization, or calibration subsystems, applying relevant expertise to troubleshoot systems and control loops, establish containment actions, determine root cause, and independently address critical technical issues.
Facilitate clear communication of technical issues and development activities across Integration, Customer Support, and other relevant teams, serving as a central point of contact and information resource for engineers.
Monitor and report system and plasma submodule performance, identify performance gaps, and define solutions or improvements to enhance system stability, availability, and efficiency.
Plan, coordinate, and execute subsystem- and system-level integration activities for automation and control functions, qualification, design verification and regression testing in laboratory test bench and cleanroom fabrication environments.
Analyze test results using time-series data, equipment logs, diagnostic signals, statistical methods, and engineering analysis tools to determine whether control functions meet performance, stability, availability, and diagnostic requirements.
Prepare clear test summaries and qualification reports documenting test configuration, execution results, identified gaps, technical conclusions, risks, and recommended next actions.
Organize, coordinate, optimize, lead, coach, develop and appraise employees within the person's expertise / team.
Applies broad knowledge in sensors, actuators, control algorithms, automation, software, and data analysis tools to drive control system improvements to enable continuously increased EUV power and system availability.
Documents work results with system requirements, design specifications, procedures, and training materials.
Travel to customer sites to provide onsite support, including hands-on upgrade and troubleshooting in cleanroom fabrication facilities.
May require travel international dependent on business needs (up to 20%).
Occasional afternoon, evening, or weekend shift work may be required based on testing and support schedules.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Algorithms and Controls Specific
Contributes to development, simulation, implementation, and tuning of complex algorithms involving controller design, optimization, system identification, signal processing and stochastic signal analysis for the EUV Source & other equipment used in the semiconductor industry.
Works on broadly defined system- and subsystem- level specifications to determine appropriate top-down automation, control system, algorithm architecture and performance criteria.
Develop and maintain traceable requirements, interface definitions, and design specifications for automation logic and control algorithms implementation.
Translate system requirements, field observations, and known failure modes into structured test objectives, test cases, acceptance and verification plan for control-system releases and corrective actions.
Designs and builds tools that allow debugging, analysis and performance evaluation of algorithms. Determines the root cause for algorithm failure, ensuring correct interfaces, timing behavior, diagnostics in products in the manufacturing factory and field installed units in high-level escalations.
Mentors junior level algorithm engineers in controls fundamentals, algorithm development, structured troubleshooting, test design through technical guidance and assistance.
Investigates the feasibility of applying scientific and mathematical control design principles and concepts to potential inventions and products.
Plans and executes laboratory research pertaining to control algorithm design and validation in lab test bench and/or cleanroom

Possess a Bachelors’ degree in Controls, Mechanical, Computer, Chemical, Aerospace or Electrical Engineering or Physics.
Master's degree is highly regarded.

Experience designing and implementing practical feedback control or optimization systems of significant complexity.
Experience with data visualization tools (ex. Databricks, Grafana, Spotfire)
Knowledge of modern control theory, optimization, stochastics, and some nonlinear control theory.
Excellent knowledge of and experience with Matlab and Simulink
Working knowledge of C/C++ and Python desirable.
Ability to carry out typical lab activities, such as mount/unmount electrical modules, connecting cables, read LED status and perform simple troubleshooting.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to use MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and electronic e-mail systems.

Job Description: Regional Category Strategy Manager MLP – Asia
Introduction to ASML Sourcing & Procurement
ASML’s supply chain is unique in the industry. As a system integrator in a complex ecosystem, ASML depends on suppliers for the majority of cost of goods sold.
This model enables flexibility and growth, while requiring suppliers to meet ASML’s standards for quality, logistics, technology, cost and sustainability.
Sourcing & Procurement builds the supplier capabilities needed to deliver ASML’s customer commitments, while managing short-term challenges and developing strategic, mutually beneficial supplier relationships. It is category-focused, with strong account management accountability for the total business relationship and material availability, supported by Centers of Excellence for escalations and cross-functional cluster support.
The position
As Regional Category Strategy Manager Asia, you will shape the Asian long-term supplier strategy for critical products in Machined Ceramics and Glass, optical components and assemblies, light sources, silicon-based devices, metrology and photonics.
A key responsibility will consist of scouting and developing the Asia supply chain for the afore mentioned technologies, with a special eye to securing ASML cost and quality goals; this includes enabling and nurturing relationships at multiple levels in the organization, at ASML and its suppliers
You will work at the intersection of technology, business strategy and supplier ecosystem development, influencing decisions central to ASML’s ability to scale, innovate and serve customers.
The role co-defines, aligns and drives category strategies and supplier selections, ensuring stakeholder alignment and effective execution at supplier and account level.
You will collaborate with the Industrial Strategy Department on key make-buy decisions.
Given their strategic importance, category strategies require alignment and approval from ASML the leadership of Business Lines and of Development & Engineering (D&E), as well as the relevant Board of Management representatives.
Key deliverables and responsibilities
Lead Asia supplier landscape development, including supplier scouting, pre-screening, site visits, benchmarking, competency mapping, and supplier shortlisting.
Build a structured Asia supplier-development funnel linked to category strategy, technology roadmaps, benchmarking supplier readiness in terms of Quality, Logistics, Technology, Cost, Sustainability (QLTCS) performance, Intellectual Property protection readiness, and fit with ASML strategy and way of working.
Identify supplier capability gaps and define development actions to enable manufacturing of high complexity components, assemblies, modules, in support of present and future technology requirements.
Translate regional supplier intelligence into strategic recommendations for supplier selection, supplier development, capability investment, risk mitigation, and executive decision-making.
Co-develop and maintain global category strategies, including long-term vision, supplier landscape, technology roadmaps, commercial models, risk-reward considerations and business alignment.
Drive approved category strategies at supplier and account level, monitor deployment gaps and resolve or escalate issues.
Prepare supplier selection proposals, stakeholder alignment and decision-making forums.
Ensure Sourcing & Procurement is engaged early in design, requirement definition and specification development for new product introductions.
Represent the category in cross-functional forums, working closely with D&E and Research & Technology and securing executive support where required.
Support Industrial Strategy in make-buy assessments.
Advance internal and supplier technology roadmaps by defining targets, supporting decision points and aligning priorities across functions.
Purpose of the category strategies
Secure long-term supply chain capabilities for ASML’s business goals.
Build resilience and business continuity in critical supply chains.
Enable ASML technology roadmaps while protecting intellectual property.
Support ASML and customer cost and quality roadmaps.
Contribute to ASML ESG ambitions and manage business cycles.
Candidate profile: education, experience and background
Experience working with suppliers in Asia is beneficial and can help accelerate the effectiveness within the role
Master’s or PhD degree, preferably in a technical, business, supply chain or strategy-related field.
Typically 10–15 years of experience in advanced technology, such as semiconductor, defense, telecom or a similar industry.
Strategy experience in a large international company or consulting; commercial experience in sourcing, account management or product management is an advantage.
Strong technical background in semiconductor equipment design and/or manufacturing.
Skills and personal qualities
Strong analytical and conceptual thinking, with the ability to simplify and structure complex issues.
Ability to influence without formal authority and drive decisions using technology, commercial, geopolitical and execution insights.
Ability to translate data, observations and business context into strategic recommendations and actionable plans.
Strong collaboration skills with internal and external leaders, partners and stakeholders, including the ability to find workable compromises.
Management maturity, organizational awareness and sound judgment in multidisciplinary and virtual teams.
Clear, concise and impactful communication, including presentations to senior executives and decision-making bodies.
Planning discipline, execution focus, entrepreneurship and resilience in a demanding, fast-changing environment.
The team
The Category Strategy Manager will be based in Tokyo and report to the Head of Cluster Strategy for the MLP cluster, who is based in Veldhoven, the Netherlands. The Category Strategy team consists of 7–8 experienced professionals located in the Netherlands, the USA and Asia. It works closely with the Industrial Strategy MLP team and Asia Transfers program; together, the extended team counts about 15 people. Close collaboration with the wider MLP cluster, especially account teams, is essential.

This role is part of the Digital Foundation Solutions(DFS), which includes a Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) as a global team, with presence in the Netherlands and US. This team’s vision is to provide a flexible and reliable cloud platform to enable accelerated and sustainable adoption of cloud across ASML, maximizing the ability to realize its benefits while reducing risks. In this role you will work closely together with products owners, cloud & security architects, cloud engineers, cloud FinOps specialists and financial resources to help build a secure and robust enterprise-grade cloud platform and managing the DFS US budget processes in conjunction with the NL finance resources.
The DFS cloud US Team is responsible for cloud onboarding and solutioning to guide other ASML DevOps teams in their onboarding journey to cloud, which includes aspects around architecture, FinOps and security. During the cloud journey the stakeholders will need to have cost insights available through the ASML cloud FinOps tool, Flexera, and will need guidance on how to fulfill their cloud FinOps roles and responsibilities. Moreover, besides reporting, the FinOps team members are very focused on monitoring efficiency metrics, advising and producing recommendations on how to use cloud resources in an efficient way without harming the technical functionality and performance.
The Cloud Optimization Engineer will be responsible to provide sufficient FinOps insights to enable the workload teams to be compliant with the budget they have allocated, define guidelines, best practices and spot-on recommendations on how to use cloud resources efficiently, as well as promote the adoption of the FinOps governance, tooling and community of practice. There will also be additional responsibilities covering Private Cloud expenditures and on-prem DFS capex/opex monthly financials.

ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States.
Job Description:
This position is for a highly skilled with innovative attitude and motivated Process Engineer to join ASML Wilton Factory Optical Fabrication team. This role supports daily manufacturing operations, drives continuous improvement, and partners closely with engineering, quality, and production teams to advance equipment capability and product performance.
Role and responsibilities:
Champion a safety-first culture by identifying potential hazards, implementing risk mitigation strategies, and ensuring all work adheres to established EHS safety protocols
Develop, document, and improve CNC machining processes, programs, and workflows for new and existing products.

Perform hands-on process trials and support qualification of new equipment, materials, and process changes to enhance production performance.
Support root-cause analysis and corrective actions for quality deviations or nonconformances.
Drive 5S and workplace organization around CNC areas.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Optical, Materials, or related field)
Minimum 10 years of experience in optical fabrication process engineering or a related manufacturing environment
Hands-on experience with optics fabrication techniques, including CNC machining, polishing, and surface inspection
Proficient in root cause analysis (RCA) and lean manufacturing tools

Demonstrated ability to lead problem-solving initiatives and implement process improvements
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with ability to work effectively across different departments
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under tight deadlines

Experience in a semiconductor or CNC manufacturing environment
Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DOE) and Six Sigma methodologies
Solid Modeling Software, NX
CAM Software, Mastercam
Proficiency in data analysis tools such as JMP, Minitab, or equivalent software
Experience with SAP or MES systems
Knowledge of cleanroom protocols and practices

Ability to analyze complex data, interpret technical documents, and communicate findings effectively

As a manufacturing test engineer, you will perform all factory acceptance tests required to certify a DUV laser system for customer delivery. You will be part of a highly skilled team that tests all lasers for the Cymer Light Source division. Our DUV light source consists of an intricate network of process gases, optics, electronics, high-power electrical, metrology and control systems. In this hands-on position you will have the opportunity to work with all of these components and become a system expert. You will be the key to delivering a quality product through testing, issue identification and resolution, and finding potential improvements.
Role & Responsibilities
Tests laser systems and validates manufacturing processes.
Performs functional tests, optical alignment, equipment calibration, station setup.
Recommends changes in design, methods, and procedures to enhance product quality.
Solves problems through troubleshooting and leveraging available resources.
Uses standardized tools and electronic equipment (i.e., torque wrenches, electric and pneumatic screwdrivers and ball drivers, lifting equipment, computers, oscilloscopes) to assemble/install/remove or perform testing and troubleshooting.
Trains others on areas of test processes and troubleshooting when required.
Performs a variety of moderately complex technical service/support duties requiring specialized knowledge (i.e., sub-assembly, assembly, build, test, R&D, QA).
Utilizes functional area databases to run reports and analyze/trend data; Makes recommendations to management in order to meet production needs.
Interfaces with design engineers to support special tests and experiments with detailed instructions.
Documents and monitors parameters critical to product quality or operations.
Uses specialized test equipment such as leak testing, Hi - Pot and alignment instruments.
Pressurizes gas and water systems with helium and troubleshoots failures.
Reads and understands business documents such as Bills of Material, routing sheets, inventory records and work instructions.
Maintains a clean work area, and is responsible for designated tools (routine maintenance and calibration).
Installs electrical connectors to modules.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Physics desired.
A minimum of 2 years of related work experience preferred.
Strong engineering, technical, and physics fundamentals.
Experience working with precision optical components is desirable.
Skills & Competencies
Ability to read and interpret schematics/drawings.
Ability to translate, statistically analyze data, and effectively report problems through written and/or graphical formats.
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Able to use electric/pneumatic tools.
Ability to troubleshoot, identify and correct problems in complex software-driven electronic systems (not circuit-board troubleshooting).
Full to advanced proficiency with a wide variety of tools and equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, voltage and current probes, multi-meters, and helium sniffers).
Experience with electro-optical and/or opto-mechanical systems as well as environmental testing is desired.
Experience with Automated Testing Equipment, LabVIEW preferred.
Ability to perform in-process quality inspections of components and/or full assemblies within the Manufacturing area(s).
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and 5S principles preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Requires general computer skills and knowledge.
Can learn and apply new information or skills.
Can work under deadlines.

Introduction
ASML US, including its affiliates and subsidiaries, bring together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon.
Job Mission
As a Competence Engineer, this role will support product development by performing hands-on build, prototyping, proof-of-concept, diagnostic and troubleshooting testing, of electrical and mechanical systems, in a consistent, repeatable, safe and efficient manner. Another key responsibility is to support at least one of ASML’s development labs which includes maintaining testing equipment, instrumentation, and tooling in a ready state, including but not limited to calibration tracking, configuration management of test stands and test equipment, and safety monitoring as well as other tasks in support of projects and production operations. The third primary responsibility is ownership, planning, and scheduling activities within the lab, and maintaining the lab with a 5S environment. Basic computer skills are required for test stand operation, as well as for scheduling and communicating with customers.
Role and responsibilities:
Serve as the owner (i.e., steward) of one or more ASML D&E laboratories.
Process requests for lab space, lab equipment, or lab technician project support received through the Wilton D&E Lab Request App or as assigned.
Maintain proactive communication with lab customers regarding Lab Request status, scheduling, unanticipated circumstances, or needed changes to their tests.
Support, train, and supervise users on the correct use of communal lab equipment. (Note: Lab Ownership does not equate to Tool Ownership—many Tools within D&E Labs have Tool Owners that are not Lab Owners.)
Support the setup and operation of test equipment, data collection, and analysis.
Actively participate in regular alignment and/or lab operation excellence meetings.
Work without direct supervision and manage priority of multiple tasks.
Maintain positive attitude and role model ASML values of Collaborate, Challenge, and Care.
Provide cross-lab support to colleagues as needed.
Promote the use of the HTC SharePoint page to inform customers of lab Ways of Working (WoW) and space request processes.
Review and keep the information on the lab’s SharePoint page current and accurate.
Work with Office and Lab Space Support to keep floor plan up-to-date.
Approve Lab Access Requests on a timely manner, enabling qualified requestors to gain badge access to the lab.
Ensure project activities are appropriately identified with signage (e.g., the 1st page of lab request).
Operate hoisting /lifting equipment, where appropriate and when properly trained and authorized.
Maintain certification and operate as an Informed Electrical Worker (IEW).
Purchase general-use lab supplies, consumables, and support equipment.
Ensure lab equipment and facilities are in good working order and coordinate repairs when required.
Maintain the calibration status of the lab and lab equipment per ASML and ISO requirements.
Maintain equipment inventory.
Enable lab technicians and lab users to follow ASML WoW, PPE, 5LSR, Green Tag, LOTO, and other safety policies.
Align with EHS to ensure clarity regarding required safety trainings prior to granting lab access.
Perform safety and housekeeping audits and respond to findings in a reasonable time frame.
Store, handle, and dispose of project-related materials in accordance with applicable procedures and requirements.
Maintain test benches, prototypes, and miscellaneous hardware.
Promote 5S+1 (Sort, Set, Shine, Standardize, Sustain, and Safety), keeping the laboratory safe and organized.
Technical Responsibilities:
Read, understand, and execute using wiring diagrams, schematics, blueprints, and electrical/mechanical technical documentation.
Assemble, wire, and commission test stands and/or electrical cabinets, where appropriate.
Use standard mechanical and electrical tools and/or gauges.
Fabricate and/or assemble advanced mechanical and/or electrical assemblies/functional models (FUMO), where appropriate.
Apply an analytical and pragmatic approach to troubleshooting.
Apply knowledge to solve problems according to documented procedures or professional expertise, as needed.
Identify, initiate, and support continuous improvement activities / optimize assigned project activities.
Specify and operate advanced instrumentation (mixed-signal oscilloscopes, mechanical alignment and metrology tools, programmable power supplies, climatic chambers, optical alignment tools, thermal test equipment, data acquisition modules, etc.)
Comply with applicable UL, OSHA, and NFPA standards and regulations.
Mechanical Responsibilities:
Use of a wide range of hand tools, drill press, arbor press, chop saw, etc.
Use of a wide range of measuring devices such, as calipers, micrometers, indicators, height stands, force gauges, and flow meters.
Perform precision measurements at micron and sub-micron level.
Perform plumbing of pneumatic and water lines.
Contribute areas of specialty that benefit the group and project teams.
This position is located on-site in Wilton, CT. It requires daily onsite presence to attend in-person work-related events, inspections, trainings and meetings and to further ensure teamwork, collaboration and innovation.
Education and experience
High School Degree with 5 years relevant work experience
High School Degree and Technical Certification (i.e. Electronic Technician) with 3 years relevant work experience
Associates Degree with 3 years relevant work experience
Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, electrical or mechanical

Experience working in a cleanroom (preferred)

Introduction to the job
As a Computer Systems Platform Designer, you will help develop and deliver advanced computer system platforms that enable ASML products to achieve their performance, reliability and industrialization targets. You will work on technically challenging designs within a multidisciplinary environment, contributing to modules that directly influence system functionality and product quality.
This JG7 role combines independent technical ownership with strong collaboration. You will take responsibility for module-level solutions, influence adjacent technical domains and support the successful realization of system architectures while balancing quality, performance and delivery commitments.
Role and responsibilities
You will work independently within your area of expertise while contributing to larger development activities with engineers, architects, project leaders, suppliers and other stakeholders. As a Computer Systems Platform Designer, you will:
Lead or execute complex design activities for computer system and electronics solutions.
Own module-level designs and coordinate technical contributions from multiple engineers.
Define, document and implement design solutions that align with system requirements and architectural decisions.
Contribute to feasibility studies, concept development, technical validation and decision making throughout the product lifecycle.
Integrate subsystems into complete system solutions and support configuration management and product realization activities.
Define product specifications, testing approaches and validation activities to ensure product quality and performance.
Guide and support one to two engineers in developing components, modules and technical solutions.
Education and experience
You bring the technical depth and engineering maturity required to operate independently in a complex development environment.
A bachelor's degree or master's degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering or a related technical field.
3+ years of experience in computer system, electronics or platform design, with the ability to work independently.
Experience delivering technical solutions within multidisciplinary engineering projects.
Experience defining requirements, developing design solutions and supporting system integration activities.
Experience contributing to product qualification, testing and technical validation.
Ability to collaborate with engineers from adjacent technical domains and external partners.
Skills
Working at the cutting edge of technology brings new challenges and opportunities every day. You will collaborate with supportive colleagues from different disciplines and contribute to decisions that influence product performance and system behavior. To thrive as a Computer Systems Platform Designer, you will need:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate challenges from multiple perspectives.
Ownership and accountability for technical solutions, quality and delivery commitments.
Solid knowledge of computer systems, electronics or platform design at module or subsystem level.
Understanding of system-level interactions and neighboring technical domains.
Effective communication and collaboration skills across teams, projects and disciplines.
Coaching and mentoring skills to support the development of less experienced engineers.
Other information
As a Computer Systems Platform Designer, you will collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders, including suppliers and customers, as part of larger development efforts. You will follow ASML quality and safety standards and contribute to a safe working environment.
This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

Introduction to the job
ASML Corporate Real Estate (CRE) enables business continuity by providing safe, reliable, and efficient facilities that support our fast‑growing operations. We are looking for a Manager, Asset Management to lead asset lifecycle strategies, maintenance performance, and facility resilience across our Taiwan sites. This role ensures our critical utilities, building systems, and infrastructure operate with maximum uptime and optimal reliability.
The Senior Asset Management Expert is a strategic technical leader responsible for developing and driving Asset Management excellence across the CRE Taiwan portfolio, including buildings, facilities, utilities, and critical infrastructure.
This role will establish and lead Asset Reliability Programs, Long-Term Asset Planning (LTAP), Lifecycle Cost Management, Asset Performance Analytics, and Asset Governance frameworks to enable the transition from execution-driven maintenance to risk-based, lifecycle-driven Asset Management. The position serves as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor to CRE leadership, providing data-driven recommendations to optimize reliability, business continuity, sustainability, and total cost of ownership.
Role and responsibilities
Asset Management Strategy & Governance
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve the Strategic Asset Management Plan (SAMP).
Establish governance frameworks, asset lifecycle strategies, and decision-making methodologies.
Translate business requirements into asset management objectives, targets, and investment plans.
Drive Asset Management maturity improvements aligned with ISO 55000 principles and industry best practices.
Support portfolio transition programs and strategic infrastructure planning.
Asset Reliability & Risk Management
Establish and lead a formal Asset Reliability Program.
Implement Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), FMEA/FMECA, RCA, and Reliability Growth programs.
Define reliability KPIs including MTBF, MTTR, availability, uptime, and asset performance indicators.
Conduct criticality assessments and reliability risk evaluations for critical systems and utilities.
Lead investigations of major failures, identify root causes, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Lifecycle Planning & Asset Control
Develop and govern Long-Term Asset Plans (LTAP) for all critical assets.
Perform condition assessments, Remaining Useful Life (RUL) analysis, and asset health evaluations.
Establish risk-based renewal and replacement strategies.
Drive asset data quality improvement, including asset registers, BOMs, technical documentation, and asset hierarchy structures.
Integrate lifecycle risk, business impact, and investment priorities into asset decisions.
​Asset Analytics & Performance Management
Develop asset performance dashboards and predictive analytics capabilities.
Analyze asset health, maintenance performance, reliability trends, failure modes, and lifecycle costs.
Enable data-driven decision-making across maintenance, reliability, and capital planning.
Improve asset information management and digital asset governance.
Establish asset performance benchmarks and maturity metrics.
Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) & Investment Optimization
Lead lifecycle cost modeling and asset investment strategies.
Provide recommendations on OPEX versus CAPEX decisions.
Develop business cases for sustainment, replacement, and infrastructure investments.
Support investment prioritization based on risk, condition, reliability, and business impact.
Improve cost transparency at asset and system levels.
Organizational Capability Development
Act as the technical authority for Asset Management within CRE Taiwan.
Mentor Asset Managers, Facility Managers, Engineers, and IFM partners.
Establish Asset Management competency frameworks and training roadmaps.
Strengthen internal capabilities in lifecycle management, reliability engineering, and analytics.
Drive knowledge management and best-practice implementation across the organization.
IFM Performance & Vendor Management
Support transition to IFM 2.0 operating model.
Define outcome-based KPIs related to reliability, lifecycle performance, and asset data quality.
Review IFM asset performance and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure service providers contribute to Asset Reliability and Lifecycle Planning objectives.
Establish clear asset ownership and accountability models between CRE and IFM partners.
​Education and experience
- Bachelor’s degree or above in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, Facilities Engineering, or related field.- 7+ years in facility operations, asset management, or utilities engineering in hi‑tech, semiconductor, pharma, or mission‑critical environments.- Experience in maintenance management, reliability engineering, and technical troubleshooting.- Emergency response leadership experience is a strong plus.
Minimum 10-15 years of experience in Asset Management, Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Management, Industrial Facilities, Utilities, or Manufacturing Operations.
Minimum 5 years in strategic Asset Management leadership roles.
Proven experience developing: Asset Management Frameworks Long-Term Asset Plans (LTAP) Reliability Programs Asset Lifecycle Strategies Capital Planning Programs
Experience within semiconductor, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or mission-critical facility environments preferred.

Introduction to the job
Are you motivated by solving complex software and computer-related problems on advanced e-beam machines? Do you enjoy applying solid computer science fundamentals to diagnose real-world machine issues, improve system reliability, and support critical products used by customers worldwide?
We are looking for a Software Engineer with a strong foundation in computer science and hands-on software engineering skills to join the Diagnostics Tooling group. In this role, you will help diagnose, investigate, and resolve software and computer-related issues observed on customer e-beam machines, while designing and developing software tools that improve troubleshooting efficiency, automate diagnostics workflows, and strengthen our overall machine diagnostics capability.
You will work closely with equipment specialists, architects, product owners, and stakeholders across multiple domains to analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and deliver reliable, maintainable software improvements.
Role and responsibilities
As a Software Engineer in D&E CRT(Customer response team), you will act as a software expert for software and computer-related diagnostics on e-Beam machines. You will analyze issues reported by Field team from customer sites, provide technical feedback and troubleshooting guidance, and develop software tools and test applications that improve diagnostics efficiency and support internal module validation.
Your responsibilities include:
Acting as a D&E software expert for software and computer-related issues reported by Field from customer e-beam machines
Analyzing Field feedback, diagnosing symptoms, identifying possible root causes, and providing practical troubleshooting recommendations
Developing software tools to reduce the effort and complexity for Field engineers when investigating software, computer, and machine-related problems at customer sites
Building diagnostics and automation tools for log collection, system health checks, issue reproduction, data analysis, and root cause investigation on e-beam machines
Supporting the development of internal D&E module test software, including software for module communication, test execution, result analysis, and validation workflows
Contributing to software solutions involving module communication interfaces, image processing workflows, and image algorithm validation where applicable
Working closely with Field team, equipment specialists, architects, and software teams to translate technical problems into maintainable software solutions
Writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code for diagnostic tools, test utilities, backend components, and integration software
Continuously improving diagnostics workflows, tool usability, and knowledge transfer between D&E and Field teams
Collaborating effectively across D&E, Field, application, and equipment domains to drive customer-impacting issues toward resolution
Education and experience
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, or equivalent
At least 10 years of professional software development experience, preferably in equipment, diagnostics, automation, test software, or engineering tool development
Strong hands-on programming experience with Python and C++
Experience with at least one GUI framework or library, such as Qt, PySide, WinForms, WPF, or similar
Experience or exposure to image algorithms, image processing, general algorithms
Familiarity with computer and equipment interfaces such as RS232, Ethernet, PCIe, and related communication concepts
Basic understanding of Windows and Linux driver concepts, device communication, and system-level troubleshooting
Skills
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills for software and computer-related issues on complex equipment
Ability to analyze logs, system behavior, communication traces, diagnostic data, and issue reproduction results
Ability to translate Field-reported customer-site issues into actionable technical investigation plans
Good software design and implementation skills for diagnostic tools, test utilities, automation tools, and integration software
Good understanding of operating systems, networking, device communication, and equipment integration troubleshooting
Experience with Git-based development workflows for engineering software or internal tools
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to Field, DnE, application, and equipment stakeholders
Other information
Curious and analytical problem solver who enjoys investigating complex technical issues
Able to understand system interactions across software, computer, communication, and equipment domains
Ability to establish, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux environments for engineering software, diagnostics tools, and test applications
Takes ownership and drives issues from investigation to practical resolution
Comfortable working with ambiguity in a fast-paced engineering environment
Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively across Field, DnE, application, and equipment teams
Team player who shares knowledge and supports continuous improvement
Open to AI-assisted development, open-source technologies, and new engineering practices

工作使命
EUV 客戶服務（CS）技術員負責在客戶現場執行 EUV 量產機的維修、故障排除、升級與例行保養（PM），確保系統可用率、良率與安全合規，並提供即時的狀態回報與知識傳遞。
工作說明
CS 組織於客戶現場執行 ASML 系統的驗證、維修、硬體更換及安裝，並確保必要知識轉移。
在指示範圍內工作、能處理常見例外並於類似情境做出合宜判斷。
與資深工程師/ 主管確認優先順序與計畫，於有限監督下完成程序並檢查結果。
參與回饋流程與持續改進活動（CI）。
工作內容（Service action + Regular PM）
A. Service action / PM
Basic Action :
SRC：DGA swap、Tin reload
SCN：SWPC、LLGV swap
DL：RFG swap、Pump swap（泵浦更換）*
Advance Action :
SRC：IF cap cleaning、SRBB swap*、Collector swap*、TCBA/CFR/FV/HFS
SCN：Top SISO、Top remove
DL：Clean water、circuit Al/Cu
B. Regular PM（例行保養）
Daily/Shift
系統健康：Alarms/Warnings、趨勢與關鍵參數巡檢
目視點檢：洩漏、異音、震動、溫度、潔淨度
耗材壽命追蹤：濾心、O-ring 等
Weekly
區域清潔與除塵（外罩、平台、治具）
冷卻/氣體/真空子系統快速點檢（含異常紀錄）

指定濾材更換、軸封/潤滑檢查
校正/對位/基準檢查，更新基準值與趨勢圖
效能驗證（Throughput/Availability）與改善建議
Post-PM/Service
Leak check、功能測試、Recipe 健康檢查
完成表單、偏差與備件消耗回報
行政支援與合規
工單/進度交接、問題描述清楚傳遞；必要時升級通報（Escalation）。
執行完美物料退回（PMR）與備件序號/時數追蹤（可追溯性）。
無塵室規範、安全與 PIP 規範遵循，落實 LOTO 與 2-person rule。
工作職責
高品質服務
依 SOP/WI 完成維修/升級/保養；關鍵步驟雙人覆核與扭力/尺寸紀錄。
執行基本故障排除並支援機台恢復，嚴格遵守作業規範。
知識建立與傳遞
維持對流程與程序的最新理解，檢視 CBT 與流程資訊。
主動向資深工程師請教及學習
物料/產品管理
辨識損壞/遺失材料並回報，確保知識產權與工具安全（鎖定/封存）。
流程優化與持續改進
提出流程改善建議，參與 CI 與問題根因分析（RCA）。
問題交接與文件管理
高品質提交物料通知、目擊報告與其他回饋文件；完整交接。
客戶溝通
口頭/書面更新系統進度與風險，維持專業形象。
個人技能
接納文化差異、良好團隊合作精神與自我驅動。
可在多變且艱鉅的環境中多工處理。
俱備中英文溝通能力與紀錄能力。
具備硬體手作技能或相關實務經驗，重視細節與紀律。
其他資訊
可依業務需求彈性出差；需輪班（含夜班）或週末支援（依專案排程）。
遵循客戶與公司安全規範，健康與安全第一。

- Technical disciplines involved;
- Size of the project team;
- Time horizon of planning activities;
- Difficulty in dealing with external suppliers;
- Number of stakeholders with different interests or objectives;

Plans and coordinates the identification, elicitation of requirements; conducts analysis of those requirements for completion and alignment; foresees business trends, manages requirements throughout the life of the project; and coordinates the verification of the end deliverable. At the end of a small project evaluate deliverables and performance against initial goals and triple constraints, extract lessons learned, and assess if there is a need for additional actions to maximize adoption of project deliverables.
